card.name: Geriatric dosing sentences, linking words
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, the, their, have, greater) inside geriatric-use statements about elderly patients, just before terms like physical condition or decreased renal function.

modes.label: Age and physical condition
modes.description: The word 'and' after 'age' in advice about reduced doses for elderly patients.
modes.example: Elderly patients should be given reduced doses commensurate with their age<< and>> physical condition ( 8.5 )

modes.label: Reflecting greater frequency
modes.description: 'the' or 'greater' in 'reflecting the greater frequency of decreased hepatic, renal' for elderly dose selection.
modes.example: usually starting at the low end of the dosing range, reflecting<< the>> greater frequency of decreased hepatic, renal

modes.label: Elderly more likely to have
modes.description: 'have' in 'elderly patients are more likely to have decreased renal function'.
modes.example: Because elderly patients are more likely to<< have>> decreased renal function, care should be taken

card.writes: It suppresses words like mature and adult, so the text does not continue with those age words.
card.plain: It marks the small connecting words in label sentences about older patients needing cautious dosing.
